1 .  This case has arisen out of accident which occurred on Digitally signed by 06.12.2015 at Samalka Red Light near NSG Camp Link Road, RAKESH RAKESH KUMAR KUMAR SINGH Dwarka, New Delhi.
The cause of accident was rash/negligent SINGH Date:

Sonu @ Vikas vs Rajesh Kumar on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78451794/
1 2025.12.05 18:27:34 +0530 driving of vehicle no. HR-79-3470 (car) which rendered a person dead and another person injured.
The person who died is Pradeep Kumar and the person who suffered injury is Sonu.
The police registered an FIR and investigated the matter.
The police has also presented a DAR for the purpose of compensation.
The legal- heirs of Pradeep Kumar has filed claim petition for the purpose of compensation.
DAR related to deceased was tagged with the claim petition and the said case was taken as lead case with which the DAR related to injured Sonu continued.
Owner of the vehicle is Rajesh Kumar S/o Ganga Dutt and the driver is Rajesh Kumar S/o Attar Singh.
The vehicle was insured with an insurance Insurance.

2. The driver and owner appeared and filed joint reply contending that the driver was driving the vehicle properly and deceased was driving the motorcycle rashly and negligently and deceased was not wearing helmet.
The insurance company also filed reply.

On the basis of available material, the Ld. Predecessor framed following issues:
1. Whether Sonu @ Vikas sustained grievous injuries in a motor vehicle accident dt.
06.12.2015 due to rash or negligent driving of vehicle no.
HR-79-3470 being driven by respondent no.1 Rajesh Kumar and insured by respondent no. MACT No. 179/2018 Sonu @ Vikas Vs.
Rajesh Kumar & Ors

sentences.text: Page No. 3 of 5 as to why the contents of charge-sheet should not be accepted.

If Digitally signed by RAKESH the insurance company was of the view that deceased was solely RAKESH KUMAR KUMAR SINGH SINGH Date: negligent, it should have appointed its own investigator to 2025.12.05 18:27:47 +0530 investigate the accident and should have led evidence in support of its claim.
The insurance company has done neither.
It is clear that accident happened due to rash/negligent driving of Rajesh Kumar.
Issue No. 1 is decided in favour of claimants.
6. We have then to see as to what amount of compensation should be awarded.
7. The injured has not produced any proper medical bills to support any claim regarding compensation for treatment.
He has also not provided any material to show that he has suffered any loss of income due to the accident.
There is nothing to suggest that he was hospitalized for any sufficient duration.
No evidence has been provided regarding income.
Therefore, minimum wages of unskilled person applicable to Haryana shall be taken into consideration.
The minimum wages was Rs.7,600/-.
One month lump sum loss of income is accepted and Rs.7,600/- is allowed.
8. The injured had suffered grievous injuries and therefore, on account of pain and suffering Rs.10,000/- is allowed.

As far as special diet and conveyance are concerned, a sum of Rs.2,000/-
each respectively is allowed.
For nursing attendant, a sum of Rs.2,000/- is allowed.
A lump sum amount of Rs.2,000/- is allowed in favour of the injured on account of inconvenience caused due to accident.

Liability 10. Respondent no.1 Rakesh Kumar S/o Attar Singh (driver) being principal tortfeasor driving the vehicle no. HR-79-3470 in rash/ negligent manner without proper vigil resulting in accident leading to death is primarily liable.
The Rajesh Kumar S/o Ganga Dutt being owner of the vehicle is vicariously liable.

However, since offending vehicle was insured with the insurance company against third party risk so, Insurance Company (insurer) being statutorily liable under Section 150 of M.V.
Act shall pay the award amount with interest to petitioners.
11. Whenever award amount is deposited, the same be released to the injured in his bank account.

12. Let a separate Award be prepared based on the aforesaid calculation and directions, so that all the concerned persons can comply with the same.
